hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: MEMORY: if the topic is past work / a preference / a project / an account / a design, READ the matching vault note from the index (do not guess). When something permanent comes up (preference, decision, project, correction) WRITE an atomic note in the right folder (frontmatter + summary) and link it from its MOC; follow the vault's own writing rules if it has them; do not ask, mention it briefly. Never write secrets. The brief's LAST paragraph is the most important rule; in-session 'don't do X' bans hold for the whole session.
